name: Start page lists all four assessments with metadata and actions
description: The Start page server-renders a grid of exactly four assessment cards, each showing its short name, duration, question count, a 'Learn more' link, and a 'Start' button.

planSteps.description: Verify a grid of exactly four assessment cards is shown, with the short names Solstice, Turing, Pride, and Passage, and that each card displays a duration (such as '~10 min'), a question count (such as '36 questions'), a 'Learn more' link, and a 'Start' button.
